name: database-query
description: Read-only-by-default SQL access to PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB and SQLite: querying with engine-enforced read-only transactions, timeouts and row caps; full schema introspection; query plans; slow-query, index and health diagnostics; schema diff and migration generation; engine-native backup/restore. Supports several named connections; writes only on connections explicitly marked writable and only with confirmation. MongoDB is not supported. SQLite needs Node.js >= 22.13; backups need pg_dump/psql or mysqldump/mysql on PATH.
shortDescription: PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB and SQLite queries, schema and diagnostics

envVars.name: DATABASE_URL
envVars.description: Default connection URL: postgres://, mysql:// / mariadb://, or sqlite:<path>. sslmode/sslrootcert query parameters are honoured. Set this or DATABASE_URLS.

envVars.name: DATABASE_URLS
envVars.description: Extra named connections as JSON: {"name": "url"} or {"name": {"url": "...", "readOnly": false}}. Connections are read-only unless readOnly is false.

envVars.name: DATABASE_ALLOW_WRITES
envVars.description: Set to true to make the DATABASE_URL connection writable (execute_write, restore). Default: read-only.

envVars.name: DB_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Per-statement timeout in milliseconds, enforced by the database (SQLite: by killing the helper process).

envVars.name: DB_MAX_ROWS
envVars.description: Hard cap on rows returned by one execute_query call.

envVars.name: DB_BACKUP_DIR
envVars.description: Directory every backup/restore/list path is confined to. Default: ~/.dev-suite/db-backups (outside any repository).

envVars.name: DB_CLIENT_BIN_DIR
envVars.description: Directory containing pg_dump/pg_restore/psql or mysqldump/mysql when they are not on PATH.

envVars.name: DB_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ADHOC_URLS
envVars.description: Allow targetDatabaseUrl tool arguments to reach private/loopback hosts (cloud metadata stays blocked). Configured connections are always allowed.
